title: failure-event-and-outcome
description: Two kind-discriminated shapes. The failure event makes no failure silent (goal.md clause 12); the per-meeting outcome makes filed-notes = processed meetings checkable (clause 10).

oneOf.description: failure-event: one owner-visible failure, emitted instead of dying quietly

cause.description: what failed, named as the channel failure note will say it

scope.description: how much work the failure took down

oneOf.description: per-meeting-outcome: how one meeting's processing ended this cycle

outcome.description: filed: summary written and routed; amended: existing summary rewritten in place; withheld-unroutable: no write, owner asked and has not answered; skipped: no write, the owner answered `skip`; unprocessable: no write, the transcript carried nothing to summarize; failed: this meeting's processing failed

destination.description: present when the outcome wrote or rewrote a file

content-entity.description: present when the route came from the meeting's content, so the publish stage re-resolves to the same destination
